title: Cho2017 within-subject branch: decoders, eligibility, validity gates, and the frozen rules for the T4 harm sweep
frozen_before: any clean decoder accuracy, any artifact-only accuracy, and any HARM statistic whatsoever
supersedes_nothing: T2_PREREGISTRATION.json stays valid; MI_d >= 3.0 remains the feasibility gate and its 45/47 result stands
bank: cho_bank_v2 only. cho_bank v1 is void: resample_poly zero-padding rang off a residual per-channel DC of median 135158 and the donor waveforms were dominated by that ringing.

analysis_window.reason: the trial spans -2000 to 5000 ms around the cue and the instructed imagery period is 0 to 3 s; the first 0.5 s is dropped because event-related desynchronisation does not develop instantly, and the window ends where the instructed imagery ends rather than running into the blank screen
analysis_window.donor_cut: central 625 samples of each stored 3 s donor window, so host and donor are the same length; the donor is already filtered, so cutting inward introduces no edge
analysis_window.chosen_before: any decoder was fitted on this dataset

cross_validation.scheme: 5 contiguous folds over the trial sequence, per subject, per class
cross_validation.reason: Cho2017 does not expose run boundaries, so leave-one-run-out is unavailable; contiguous folds approximate the run structure and avoid the temporal leakage that random folds would introduce
cross_validation.guarantee: every decision in T4 is taken by the fold model that did not see that trial, matching the discipline of the BNCI branch
cross_validation.decoder: CSP n_components=8, reg=None, log=True, norm_trace=False, transform_into=average_power; LDA solver=lsqr, shrinkage=auto

donor_purity_threshold.definition: purity = 1 - P_20_80(subject's median resting window) / P_20_80(donor window)
donor_purity_threshold.interpretation: at most 10 per cent of the injected power is the subject's own background
donor_purity_threshold.reason_for_using_purity_not_MI_d: purity is defined in the band that is actually injected; MI_d is defined in 40-100 Hz where nothing is injected. Per-window Spearman between them is +0.968, so they rank the same donors, but only purity carries a direct interpretation.
donor_purity_threshold.lower_bound_caveat: purity is a LOWER bound on the muscle fraction, not an estimate, because alpha and beta are higher at rest than during any task, so the subtracted background is overstated
donor_purity_threshold.DEVIATION_DECLARED: the purity distribution of the 47 confirmatory subjects was visible in the T2c output before this threshold was set. That is a departure from ideal blinding. Mitigations: the threshold is justified physically and independently of that distribution; the 15 locked subjects have been used for nothing and stay sealed; results are reported at all three thresholds.

eligibility.reason: the same rule already frozen in the BNCI branch; a decision flip on a decoder at chance means nothing
eligibility.applied_to: out-of-fold clean accuracy on the frozen imagery window

cohort.sealed: locked, 15 subjects, opened once after the development analysis has been run and written
cohort.pilot: subjects 1-5, reported separately, excluded from every confirmatory count

arms.A_within: donor = subject i's own jaw windows, host = subject i
arms.B_between: donor = jaw windows from subjects other than i, host = subject i
arms.C_rest: donor = subject i's own resting windows, host = subject i
arms.donor_matching: arms B and C are subsampled to the same number of donors per host as arm A, redrawn 25 times, statistic taken per draw and the median reported across draws; without this the comparison is a comparison of counting noise
arms.arm_A_ceiling: 3 donors per host, imposed by the 10 s length of the jaw block, and nothing can be done about it

primary_endpoint.comparison: arm A versus arm B, paired by subject, Wilcoxon signed rank
primary_endpoint.reason: simulation under a linear dependence model shows the interaction-required fraction moves by a few per cent when the cross-term correlates with the margin, while the symmetry ratio moves from 0.98 to 0.68 over the same range; the fraction is nearly blind to dependence and the symmetry ratio is not
primary_endpoint.simulation_caveat: that simulation assumed one specific dependence model and is a hypothesis about the sensitivity of the two statistics, not a measured property of these data

secondary_endpoints: measured |rho| between the CSP projections z and u in arm A, which is the number that limitation 10.3.4 currently lacks
arm C versus arm A, to show the effect is muscle and not the subject's own background

artifact_only_pooled.rule: decoder fed the scaled donor alone, no clean EEG; pooled over all trial-donor pairs in the arm
artifact_only_pooled.consequence_if_failed: arm A is void and is withdrawn, exactly as the synthetic EMG branch was withdrawn in section 9.3

artifact_only_A_versus_B.rule: artifact-only accuracy in arm A must not exceed arm B by more than 0.03
artifact_only_A_versus_B.reason: arm A donors contain the subject's own background and the decoder was trained on that subject; this is the sharp test for own-background leakage and the BNCI branch could not run it

validity_gates_run_before_any_endpoint_i.directional_bias: reported, never used as evidence; section 6.4 already showed the agreement figure is a mechanical consequence of a shared bias direction

snr_grid_db.per_subject_natural_point: each donor additionally scaled to that subject's own measured natural SNR
snr_grid_db.reason_for_extension: the natural SNR measured on 47 subjects has median -9.52 dB and spans -32.42 to +4.15 dB, so only 15 of 47 fall inside the original grid and 30 fall harsher than it; the original eight are kept unchanged so the BNCI comparison stays exact
snr_grid_db.natural_snr_convention: clean RMS is the per-subject median over the frozen imagery window in 8-32 Hz, donor RMS is in 20-80 Hz; this is per-subject, unlike the single scalar clean reference used in the BNCI branch, and the difference is stated rather than absorbed

numeric_prediction_frozen_before_the_run.basis: the saturation law of section 7, fitted only over +2 to -7 dB, where interaction-required falls from 0.0525 to 0.0150
numeric_prediction_frozen_before_the_run.prediction_2: interaction-required decreases monotonically from -7 dB through -30 dB
numeric_prediction_frozen_before_the_run.why_this_matters: these are extrapolations outside the range the law was derived on, they cost no extra computation, and a confirmed out-of-range prediction is far stronger evidence than any in-range fit
numeric_prediction_frozen_before_the_run.if_refuted: published as a bound on the law's domain, not deleted

published_regardless_of_outcome: clean accuracy of every subject, including those failing eligibility
both validity gates with their numbers
the saturation prediction and whether it held
the purity threshold deviation stated above
